newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Energy sells land for $24 mln.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Energy sells land for $24 mln.

text.p: Santa Fe Energy Resources said it sold surface lands in Brea, California, for development of Olinda Heights, a 284-acre planned residential community.
SunCal Companies Inc, a land developer based in Orange County, California, acquired the property for a purchase price of $24 million, a statement from Santa Fe said.

SunCal will develop the land at Olinda Heights, install all major infrastructure improvements and sell finished lots to merchant home builders, with completion of model homes anticipated in the fall of 1997, Santa Fe said.
